title: Drift Detection coverage
intro: Every CloudFormation drift operation the emulator advertises, and what Emuplane
does with it. Detection completes synchronously: it compares the properties the
template set with the service's current record, and records `DriftInformation`
on the stack and on each checked resource. There is no console action.
The README row also describes property-level drift for a set of resource types
and assigns `NOT_CHECKED` to every other type; those are behaviour notes rather
than operations, so the ledger lists only the four callable operations.
